comment.el: <remarkFreeTexts order="1"><title>Διάφορα</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Η Lara Magoni υποστήριξε την πρόταση ψηφίσματος RC-B10-0101/2024/REV1.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>

comment.it: <remarkFreeTexts order="1"><title>Varie</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Lara Magoni ha sostenuto la proposta di risoluzione RC-B10-0101/2024/REV1.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.pt: <remarkFreeTexts order="1"><title>Diversos</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Lara Magoni apoiou a proposta de resolução RC-B10-0101/2024/REV1.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.ga: <remarkFreeTexts order="1"><title>Aon ghnó eile</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Thacaigh Lara Magoni leis an tairiscint i gcomhair rúin RC-B10-0101/2024/REV1.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.ro: <remarkFreeTexts order="1"><title>Diverse</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Lara Magoni a susținut propunerea de rezoluție RC-B10-0101/2024/REV1.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
comment.en: <remarkFreeTexts order="1"><title>Miscellaneous</title><remarkFreeText><translation>Lara Magoni had supported joint motion for a resolution RC-B10-0101/2024/REV1.</translation></remarkFreeText></remarkFreeTexts>
